seo.title: A 3,400-Year-Old Royal Secret Unearthed on Clay Tablets
seo.description:
Archaeologists uncovered 131 cuneiform tablets revealing a deadly epidemic and a nursing princess who died during King Tudhaliya II's reign. This royal tragedy remained buried for 3,400 years until now.

#Archaeology #History #AncientHistory #Cuneiform

Sources:
- https://www.nationalgeographic.com/history/article/hittites-cuneiform-tablets-discovery
- https://www.ancientcyprus.com/news/kayalipinar-hittite-royal-archive
- https://lejournal.cnrs.fr/nos-blogs/breves-mesopotamiennes/decouverte-dune-archive-royale-hittite-a-samuha
